title: Probability one implies universal satisfaction
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $A$ be a predicate on finite Boolean lists. If the fraction of the $2^m$ Boolean strings of length $m$ that satisfy $A$ is $1$, then every Boolean string of length $m$ satisfies $A$.
